cards.name: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming

faces.name: Hidetsugu Consumes All
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I — Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.
II — Exile all graveyards.
III — Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.

faces.name: Vessel of the All-Consuming
faces.oracleText:
Trample
Whenever this creature deals damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Whenever this creature deals damage to a player, if it has dealt 10 or more damage to that player this turn, they lose the game.

faces.name: Hidetsugu, Devouring Chaos
faces.oracleText:
{B}, Sacrifice a creature: Scry 2.
{2}{R}, {T}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you exile a nonland card this way, Hidetsugu deals damage equal to the exiled card's mana value to any target.

faces.name: Hidetsugu's Poison Rite
faces.oracleText: Target player with exactly seven poison counters loses the game.

faces.name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
faces.oracleText: If target player has exactly 10 life, Hidetsugu's Second Rite deals 10 damage to that player.
